meta.sourceSHAProvenance: git rev-parse HEAD (working tree at export time)
meta.recipeCensusNote: Counts the LIVE RECIPES table only. Retired formulas are excluded, and frozen revision definitions are never added back as active routes.
meta.project: Soul of Heroes — WEB Veyra runtime
limits: Recipe records are present in runtime catalog, not a guarantee of unlock or source reachability
Source yields/bonuses are per physical node or probabilistic rolls, NOT unlimited player inventory
Creature drops are conditional on finding/killing creature; probability is per drop record
Recycler versioned durability return depends on condition, station and material availability
Fuel, repair, placement, study, research and transport are NOT automatically counted as normal consumed craft ingredients
An island POI being listed in map geometry is not proof of access
This export is Web gameplay, not a claim of parity with unmerged Godot A0/A3 native branches

energy_basic.name: Basic Energy
energy_basic.desc: Load into a Creator Core for its primary attack.

energy_refined.name: Refined Energy
energy_refined.desc: Load for techniques or combine with matching essence for Signature.

core_blast.name: Vụ nổ lớn
core_blast.desc: Common Fire Core. Reload each reserve with Basic, Refined or Refined plus Fire Essence.

core_meteor.name: Thiên thạch
core_meteor.desc: Rare Fire Core. A fireball, targeted meteor and ten-meteor storm.

core_dragon.name: Hơi thở của rồng
core_dragon.desc: Top-tier Fire Core: flamethrower, fire tornado and dragon dive.

core_elsa.name: Gươm Elsa
core_elsa.desc: Rare Water Core: ice projectile, one-second self-freeze and viewport freeze.

core_earthmother.name: Hơi thở đất mẹ
core_earthmother.desc: Common Nature Core: rock, grove and binding roots.

core_mjolnir.name: Mjolnir
core_mjolnir.desc: Rare Nature Core: thunder punch, five lightning strikes and electrical attraction.

core_demon.name: Lõi quỷ
core_demon.desc: Rare Spirit Core: directed rays, a stationary beam and a map-selected teleport.

crude_petroleum.name: Crude Petroleum
crude_petroleum.desc: Raw petroleum drawn from an authorized oil source. Refine at an Oil Refinery (4 crude + glass).

salvaged_oil.name: Salvaged Oil
salvaged_oil.desc: Recovered from car wrecks. Study a sample to learn furnace refining into generator canisters.

lubricant.name: Machine Lubricant
lubricant.desc: Refined from Salvaged Oil at an Oil Refinery. Service a motorbike within reach to halve wear for a limited distance.

damaged_drive.name: Damaged Drive
damaged_drive.desc: Finite wreck salvage. At a workbench: 1 drive + 1 scrap → 1 Mechanical Parts. Or carry to the Foundry Recycler: 1 drive → 2 Spares. The same drive is spent either way.

mechanical_parts.name: Mechanical Parts
mechanical_parts.desc: Found in industrial wrecks or made at a bench. Improve tools or maintain equipment.

fasteners.name: Forged Fasteners
fasteners.desc: Found on wrecks or made from iron and scrap. Used for field repairs, packs and canteens.

treated_canvas.name: Treated Canvas
treated_canvas.desc: Cloth treated with salt and Bitterleaf at a fire. Competes with food and medicine.

field_repair_kit.name: Field Repair Kit
field_repair_kit.desc: Consume one from the pack to restore up to 100 durability to a repairable carried tool, away from a bench.

trail_pack.name: Trail Pack
trail_pack.desc: Increases walking carry threshold by 20 kg. Occupies the back slot instead of a warm cloak.

trail_canteen.name: Trail Canteen
trail_canteen.desc: Holds 8 drinks or garden water. Crafted empty; refill at fresh water or a rain barrel.

fuel_briquette.name: Packed Fuel Briquette
fuel_briquette.desc: Compact portable fuel: 90 seconds of burn. Packing sacrifices some charcoal energy.

plank.name: Plank
plank.desc: Sawn board. Stronger walls per wood than log walls.

fiber.name: Plant Fiber
fiber.desc: Grass and reed fiber. Rope, thatch, bandages.

rich_iron_ore.name: Rich Iron Ore
rich_iron_ore.desc: High-grade ore from an iron vein. One of these with one coal makes two refined ingots.

crystal.name: Frost Crystal
crystal.desc: Cold-grown crystal from the north. Core synthesis.

raw_salt.name: Raw Salt
raw_salt.desc: Mineral crust chipped from coastal salt shale. Seasons a hearty roast.

root_broth.name: Root Broth
root_broth.desc: Warm broth simmered with Bitterleaf from garden Sunroot or from Grouse Eggs: restorative food with moisture.

herb_roast.name: Herb Roast
herb_roast.desc: A restorative cooked meal; Bitterleaf could instead become medicine.

salted_meat.name: Salted Roast
salted_meat.desc: Roast meat seasoned with gathered salt; a hearty field meal.

scrap.name: Scrap Metal
scrap.desc: Salvage from wrecks. Melts into iron.

spares.name: Spares
spares.desc: Run-local components. Research currency and advanced parts.

hide.name: Raw Hide
hide.desc: Cure at a workbench into leather.

fur.name: Fur
fur.desc: Warm pelt from a fox or hare, wild or penned. Sewn into a Fur Cloak.

shell.name: Crab Shell
shell.desc: Shore crab shell. Furnace flux for glass; competes with other uses of fuel and stone.

glass.name: Glass
glass.desc: Fused glass: furnace crystal, or stone with shell flux.

meat.name: Raw Meat
meat.desc: Risky raw. Cook at a campfire.

water_flask.name: Water Flask
water_flask.desc: Holds 4 drinks. Refill at fresh water or a rain barrel.

knife.name: Survival Knife
knife.desc: Humble but honest. Cuts fiber and flesh; very slow on wood and stone.

stone_pick.name: Stone Pickaxe
stone_pick.desc: Breaks stone and ore. Pries scrap.

industrial_pick.name: Salvager Pick
industrial_pick.desc: An improved pick: faster work on rock, ore and wrecks. Requires an improved bench.

industrial_axe.name: Salvager Axe
industrial_axe.desc: An improved axe: more work per strike on timber. Requires an improved bench.

reinforced_spear.name: Reinforced Spear
reinforced_spear.desc: A durable long-reach spear made at an improved workbench.

torch.name: Torch
torch.desc: Light in the dark. Weak weapon; can ignite.

gas_mask.name: Filter Mask
gas_mask.desc: Blocks most radiation and toxic gas.

core_fire.name: Ember Core
core_fire.desc: Hurls a fireball that ignites trees and grass. Charge spent on release.

core_earth.name: Quake Core
core_earth.desc: Raises a spike line that shatters rocks into yield.

core_frost.name: Rime Core
core_frost.desc: Frost nova; freezes shallow water into walkable ice for a while.

blueprint.name: Blueprint
blueprint.desc: Use to learn the recipe it describes. Consumed once.

keycard.name: Vault Keycard
keycard.desc: A physical Vault Keycard. New cards have limited scans; legacy cards retain one use.

fuel_can.name: Fuel Canister
fuel_can.desc: Fuels generators and motorbikes. Refined from real oil at a furnace or Oil Refinery. NOT station kindling — a campfire, furnace, refinery or research table burns solid fuel, never a canister. A packed motorbike ships dry: its first canister is made separately.

rcash.name: Ragnarok Cash
rcash.desc: Physical, unsecured. Can be lost. Deposit in an owned Rương ký gửi.

escrow_chest.name: Rương ký gửi
escrow_chest.desc: Escrow chest. Place on owned land, then deposit physical Ragnarok cash into your profile.

vehicle_drive.name: Motor Drive
vehicle_drive.desc: Gear and plate drive assembly for the utility motorbike.

refined_iron_ingot.name: Refined Iron Ingot
refined_iron_ingot.desc: Furnace-refined iron. Needed for pipe and plate.

metal_pipe.name: Metal Pipe
metal_pipe.desc: Pipe section for the piped utility frame. One paid bench cycle makes TWO sections. Recyclable at the Foundry Recycler: one section back into 1 Refined Iron Ingot, and the Mechanical Part spent to make it is NOT returned — so pipe never loops.

metal_blade.name: Metal Blade
metal_blade.desc: Cut blade stock for sword refits.

mechanical_gear.name: Mechanical Gear
mechanical_gear.desc: Precision gear for motor drives and powered mechanisms.

iron_plate.name: Iron Plate
iron_plate.desc: Plate patch for a damaged wall or door (Shift+click when repairing): restores up to 25% of its max HP per plate. Not a permanent reinforcement.

motorbike_kit.name: Utility Motorbike (packed)
motorbike_kit.desc: Packed dry: frame, drive, two iron plates and two fastener sets. No fuel is packaged — place it, then refuel with a real Fuel Canister.

cart_kit.name: Hand Cart (packed)
cart_kit.desc: Place to unpack a cargo cart.

stone_surtur.name: Stone of Surtur
stone_surtur.desc: Primordial cinder-heart claimed from Surtur in the Volcanic Core.

stone_typhon.name: Stone of Typhon
stone_typhon.desc: Primordial storm-eye claimed from Typhon at the Tempest Lair.

stone_aion.name: Stone of Aion
stone_aion.desc: Primordial hourglass-seed claimed from Aion in the Elderwood.

stone_atlas.name: Stone of Atlas
stone_atlas.desc: Primordial keystone claimed from Atlas at the Gate of Pillars.

stone_argus.name: Stone of Argus
stone_argus.desc: Primordial panopticon lens claimed from Argus in the Hall of Eyes.

stone_anubis.name: Stone of Anubis
stone_anubis.desc: Primordial scale-seal claimed from Anubis in the Necropolis.

lead_rope.name: Taming Lead
lead_rope.desc: Calm and lead a tamable wild animal (Boar, Deer, Hare, or Black Grouse) into an enclosed pen.

animal_feed.name: Fodder Bundle
animal_feed.desc: Bundled fiber and seeds for penned livestock in a Feed & Water Trough.

feather.name: Grouse Feather
feather.desc: Flight feather shed by Black Grouse; improves arrow fletching.

grouse_egg.name: Grouse Egg
grouse_egg.desc: Nutritious speckled egg laid by fed penned Black Grouse.

relic_shaleheart.name: Shaleheart Coreplate
relic_shaleheart.desc: Run-local crystal-veined quarry carapace taken from Greyback Shaleheart (-38% damage).

ronin_nodachi.name: Oathless Nodachi
ronin_nodachi.desc: Run-local long-bladed nodachi claimed from the Oathless Ronin.

tidemarshal_trident.name: Saltwick Trident
tidemarshal_trident.desc: Run-local brine-tempered polearm of the Saltwick Tidemarshal.

custodian_lantern.name: Archive Lantern
custodian_lantern.desc: Run-local silver-violet ward lantern of the Pale Custodian. Steady wide light.

claim.name: Territory Cabinet
claim.desc: Place on your foundation. 24 physical slots fund upkeep within 25 SOH tiles.

floor_triangle_wood.name: Wood Triangle Foundation
floor_triangle_wood.desc: Triangular top-view foundation piece. Current physics reserves one whole tile; half-cell join rules remain a separate gate.

wall_window_wood.name: Wood Window Wall
wall_window_wood.desc: Seals shelter, blocks movement; vision goes through its framed opening. No fake shoot-through guarantee.

wall_doorframe_wood.name: Wood Door Frame
wall_doorframe_wood.desc: Walkable frame opening. Does not seal a room; door is a separate building piece.

wall_half_wood.name: Wood Half Wall
wall_half_wood.desc: Low obstacle: blocks traversal, not sight or full shelter closure.

wall_pillar_wood.name: Wood Pillar
wall_pillar_wood.desc: One-tile support post and obstacle. True point footprint not yet modeled.

wall_triangle_wood.name: Wood Triangle Gable
wall_triangle_wood.desc: Triangular upper wall silhouette. One-tile top-down collision pending height-aware support.

fence_wood.name: Wood Fence
fence_wood.desc: Open fence: blocks walkers, lets sight through, never seals shelter.

wall_plank.name: Plank Wall
wall_plank.desc: Sawn boards: 240 HP for 6 wood, against 160 HP for 5 wood in a log wall.

door_wood.name: Wood Door
door_wood.desc: E to open/close. Creatures cannot open doors.

roof_thatch.name: Thatch Roof
roof_thatch.desc: Over a floor. Enclosed + roofed = shelter.

ceiling_wood.name: Wood Ceiling
ceiling_wood.desc: Flat overhead tile, visually separate from thatch. Not a standable upper-storey floor.

ceiling_triangle_wood.name: Wood Triangle Ceiling
ceiling_triangle_wood.desc: Triangular overhead silhouette, top-down one-tile cover until half-cell support exists.

roof_slope_thatch.name: Thatch Slope Roof
roof_slope_thatch.desc: Sloping roof silhouette. Does not provide a climbable ramp.

roof_corner_thatch.name: Thatch Corner Roof
roof_corner_thatch.desc: Corner roof silhouette with cover, not independent roof physics.

campfire.name: Campfire
campfire.desc: Cooks with fuel. Warmth + light while burning.

furnace.name: Furnace
furnace.desc: Smelts with fuel. Output waits in its slots.

oil_pump.name: Oil Pump
oil_pump.desc: Draws Crude Petroleum from an authorized oil site. Needs fuel to run; output waits in its slots. Placement needs an authorized source.

refinery.name: Oil Refinery
refinery.desc: Converts finite Salvaged Oil into Fuel Canisters and Machine Lubricant. Needs a level-2 Workbench nearby and fuel to run. The industrial batch yields fuel and lubricant together.

workbench.name: Workbench
workbench.desc: Timed crafting for tools, armor and parts.

research.name: Research Table
research.desc: Spend Spares or study specimens to unlock recipes.

garden.name: Garden Plot
garden.desc: Plant seeds; grows only while watered (rain counts).

farm_controller.name: Garden Tender
farm_controller.desc: Optional fuelled garden machinery. Link one nearby plot, barrel and chest; needs an improved workbench to build.

feed_trough.name: Feed & Water Trough
feed_trough.desc: 6-slot livestock trough. Stock fodder/crops/berries and filled water flasks (or rain/barrel) inside an enclosed pen.

base_generator.name: Field Generator
base_generator.desc: Fuel one connected load; reinforce for two. New generators require paid physical cable.

power_cable.name: Power Cable
power_cable.desc: One paid cable tile. Orthogonal connections only; dry ground, no walls.

power_switch.name: Power Switch
power_switch.desc: E toggles this physical branch on or off.

pressure_switch.name: Pressure Switch
pressure_switch.desc: Conducts only while the player stands on this plate.

ir_sensor.name: Infrared Sensor
ir_sensor.desc: Paid sensor on a cable tile. Conducts only while it has a cable path to fuelled generator capacity and sees a player or awake hostile in a clear line (range 6 tiles, walls block). E toggles it.

door_powered.name: Powered Door
door_powered.desc: Powered opening; place from the outside to set the interior emergency handle.

arrow_turret.name: Arrow Turret
arrow_turret.desc: Linked power and real arrows; shoots visible hostile creatures.

bear_trap.name: Bear Trap
bear_trap.desc: Mechanical jaw: place, arm with an Iron Plate, one paid hit when a creature steps on it, then re-arm with a plate. Three hits, then worn. Live only.

spikes.name: Spike Trap
spikes.desc: Hurts creatures that walk over it.

escrow.name: Rương ký gửi
escrow.desc: Deposit physical Ragnarok cash into profile-secured cash.

v1._status: SOH_PROVISIONAL; ORIGINAL_UNKNOWN per-item returns, condition tiers and times; v1 jobs must remain immutable

v2._status: SOH_PROVISIONAL B01. v2 supersedes v1 only for NEW jobs (recipe X:recover-v2). Queued X:recover-v1 jobs keep v1 outputs forever. Thresholds reuse recyclerV1 midCondition/highCondition. Historical LI Pipe salvage (v4): parts+refined iron, exact per-item yield and condition curve ORIGINAL_UNKNOWN.

v3._status: SOH_PROVISIONAL MEC-01 P1: recyclerV3 supersedes recyclerV2 ONLY for NEW jobs (X:recover-v3) and ONLY for the four keys listed (each v2 entry over-returned vs its craft under the cumulative-tier recovery proof, see web/src/game/industrial-proof.ts). Queued/saved X:recover-v2 jobs keep v2 outputs forever. Other v2 keys stay on v2 (proved OK). Thresholds reuse recyclerV1 midCondition/highCondition.

recycler.note: v3 supersedes v2 for its listed keys; v2 supersedes v1 for its listed keys. Do NOT sum all version outputs as concurrent offers.
